'''Udayaraj Khanal''' ({{langx|ne|उदयराज खनाल}}; born 14 January 1955) is a [[Nepalis|Nepali]] physicist specializing in cosmology.<ref name="Nepal">{{cite web|last1=Baniya|first1=Rajkumar|title=भेट्रान भौतिकशास्त्री|url=http://nepal.ekantipur.com/news/2016-11-21/20161121134637.html|website=Nepal Saptahik|accessdate=25 December 2016|language=Nepali|date=21 November 2016|archive-date=25 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161225145105/http://nepal.ekantipur.com/news/2016-11-21/20161121134637.html|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="CDP">{{cite web|title=Our PhD Students|url=http://www.cdp.edu.np/index.php/2014-11-21-04-08-36/our-phd-students|website=tucdp.edu.np|publisher=Central Department of Physics, [[Tribhuvan University|TU]]|accessdate=11 August 2016|archive-date=13 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160813001128/http://www.cdp.edu.np/index.php/2014-11-21-04-08-36/our-phd-students|url-status=dead}}</ref> Having worked in the Central Department of Physics for 34 years, he is now an [[emeritus]] [[professor]] at [[Tribhuvan University]]. As a working professor, he taught [[mathematical physics]], [[General relativity]] and [[cosmology]] to graduate students. Moreover, he was also actively engaged in the development of [[theoretical physics]] curriculum offered by the department.

Khanal is also a prominent science writer in [[Nepal]], having written articles for ''[[Kantipur (daily)|Kantipur]]'',<ref>{{cite news|last1=Khanal|first1=Udayaraj|title=गल्तीबाट सिक्नु विज्ञान|url=http://kantipur.ekantipur.com/news/2014-02-20/384502.html|accessdate=1 January 2017|work=[[Kantipur (daily)|Kantipur]]|date=20 February 2014|language=Nepali|archive-date=1 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170101162703/http://kantipur.ekantipur.com/news/2014-02-20/384502.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> ''Annapurna Post'', and ''[[Himal Khabarpatrika]]''. His articles tend to communicate science and its importance to a wider general Nepali populace. He has been the author or co-author of over 15 scientific publications.<ref name="revoscience"/>

==Early life==
Khanal was born to Yadunath and Kamala Khanal on 14 January 1955.<ref name="Hank">{{cite web|last1=Mahatara|first1=Sharad|title=नेपाली वैज्ञानिक उदयराज खनाल|url=http://www.hankweekly.com/index.php?action=news&id=3437|website=Hank Weekly|accessdate=11 August 2016|language=Nepali|date=7 August 2012|archive-date=27 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160827062526/http://www.hankweekly.com/index.php?action=news&id=3437|url-status=dead}}</ref> His father, [[Yadunath Khanal]], was a pioneer Nepali diplomat who served as the Nepali ambassador to [[India]], [[China]], and the [[United States]].

==Career==
Khanal received his PhD in astrophysics from [[Delhi University]].<ref name="Hank"/> He joined the physics department of [[Tribhuvan University]] in 1982 and retired in 2016. His style of lecturing was widely revered by his students and colleagues alike. He also teaches in [[Rato Bangala School]], Patan Dhoka, Lalitpur.

==Awards and honours==
Khanal has been the recipient of numerous national and international awards; some of which include:<ref name="revoscience">{{cite web|last1=Khanal|first1=Udayaraj|title=भौतिकशास्त्र नै मेरो रोजाई|url=http://revoscience.com/np/%E0%A4%AD%E0%A5%8C%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B6%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A4%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B0-%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%88-%E0%A4%AE%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8B-%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%9C/|website=revoscience.com|accessdate=12 August 2016|language=Nepali|date=10 December 2014}}</ref>
*Excellent Service Award, [[Tribhuvan University]] (2002)
*[[Guru Purnima|Education Day]] Award (1993)
*Young Scientist Award, [[Nepal Academy of Science and Technology]] (1989)
*UGC Junior Research Fellow, [[Delhi University]] (1981)

== Popularity ==
Dr. Khanal has appeared several times in Nepali Television sets as well as public forums where he discussed about science and try to solve popular misconceptions prevailing in Nepali Society.<ref>{{Citation|last=Koselinews Com|title=Astrology is pseudo science: Prof. Dr. Udaya RaJ Khanal|date=2016-10-05|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sHM7DxhYQvU|accessdate=2018-04-28}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=EMulyankan|title=On the death of Stephen Hawking {{!}} Interview {{!}} Udayraj Khanal|date=2018-03-16|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CQTINQBN-gg|accessdate=2018-04-28}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=Stxavier College|title=A conversation with URK Sir|date=2014-11-29|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gd4Jv6fQ8FE|accessdate=2018-04-28}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=Mountain TV|title=INTERVIEW WITH PROF DR UDAYARAJ KHANAL|date=2014-11-10|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_cdnaoLI00U|accessdate=2018-04-28}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=Bichāḥ|title=100 Years of General Relativity: Unity - Atomism, Relativism and Humanism|date=2015-12-03|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-DNnyDBKen8|accessdate=2018-04-28}}</ref>
